patterns.text:
• Confirmed fraud patterns: purchases made from an unrecognized phone, online orders shipped to a new address, card used in a city the customer has never visited, and gift card purchases while the customer was asleep.
• False positives tended to be large purchases of electronics or gift cards that were confirmed by the customer as legitimate.
• Analysts should watch for transactions with new or unrecognized devices, especially those involving gift card purchases or online orders shipped to unfamiliar addresses.
